Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Time Stop

Delinquent uses his stand ability to stop time, stunning enemies in place for 4 seconds. This ability makes Delinquent a nice unit to have in early game.

Though his attacks do not inflict Freeze (unlike JIO, Cold Mage and his evo, Snake Princess, etc.,), he is still recommended for everyone due to his strong range for his ability, extremely low CD of an active ability, especially you can activate it at the desired time. He benefits from SPA Curses extremely well due to even lowering the cooldown, but unlike Paradox (Divine Sight), his ability is hindered by Short Range challenges and the like. In addition to that, his overall cost is even cheaper than Time Wizard (Chrono)'s placement cost, costing 775¥ less.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • On Update 12.5.0, his Time Stop ability duration was nerfed from 5s to 4s.
